Do not replace unknown declarations, remove their parenthetical text, rewrite glosses, expand aliases, infer missing entries, or use private intended meanings.

metric_definition.cosine: Arithmetic mean of paired MiniLM cosine against public-message English references; decoder 'unknown' answers and structural glosses are embedded as ordinary text. Task status, discarded messages, and unscorable references are excluded. Not percent accuracy.
metric_definition.unknown_detection: Lexical flags are descriptive only; do not alter text or score inclusion.
metric_definition.missing: Historical cells must have complete alignment. Fresh follow-ups may retain missing entries as unscored with coverage shown; no invented text.
metric_definition.historical_classifications: Retained for audit only; do not alter text or score inclusion.
